studies.title: The pig
studies.caption: Pigs root through the ground for food. Early farming communities kept animals descended from wild boar, beginning a relationship that later spread across oceans.
studies.prompt: Full-body side view of a lean early domestic pig with coarse brown bristles, elongated snout and modest ears, rooting beside a traditional village garden edge. Four short sound legs with cloven hooves, curled tail not exaggerated, no giant white modern breed or people.
